construction_reading: This declaration freezes the BREAKOUT-WITH-VWAP-FILTER reading of the census slate's ORB/VWAP cell: opening-range breakouts taken only when the breakout direction agrees with the session VWAP. A VWAP-REVERSION construction (fading extensions back toward VWAP) is a different mechanism, is NOT this family, and would require its own declaration and cell. Disclosure: a family named vwap_reversion was judged in RD-007 on GOLD/SILVER/WTI 1h and failed with all 45 rows of that batch (see lineage); it was never judged on equities and it is not this family.

Expected per symbol: 961 sessions / 24,842 bars; expected panel total 372,630 bars across 15 symbols. The raw panel is never committed (SIP licence); only the provenance record is committable.
data_plan.segments: Pre-OOS 2023-01-01 to 2024-06-30 (374 sessions) is for mechanics debugging only (holdout procedure step 1). Judgement on folds W1-W5 (2024-07-01 to 2026-11-01, end exclusive), entry-time attribution, walkforward.FOLDS verbatim.

data_verification.check_1_gap_audit: Every NYSE session in 2023-01-01..2026-10-31 has exactly its expected bars (26 full / 10 early-close) at exactly the expected bar-starts; no bars on non-session dates; no duplicate timestamps. Per symbol.
data_verification.check_2_feed_volume: Per-symbol median daily volume >= 10,000,000 shares (split-adjusted, as served). Below that: consistent with a single-venue (IEX-like) feed or a corrupted panel — FAIL.
data_verification.check_3_split: No overnight open/prev-close or close/prev-close ratio in the split bands [2.70, 3.30] / [0.303, 0.367] (SRS 3:1 bands) or [9.0, 11.0] / [0.09, 0.111] (10:1 bands — this universe's in-window splits are 10:1). Extreme non-split overnight moves (>50%) are findings to eyeball, not failures. Per symbol.

check_4_cross_source.instrument: Yahoo Finance daily bars (chart API v8, interval=1d, keyless) — the data-spec addendum v3 instrument, adopted for this panel. One retrieved file per symbol, hash-pinned; a retrieved file whose hash differs from its pinned hash is a FAIL, not a re-pin.
check_4_cross_source.sampling_and_tolerances: Deterministic: 3 evenly spaced sessions per fold W1-W5 per symbol. Closes within $0.02, highs/lows within $0.05 on every sampled session. A sampled session absent from the cross-source file is a finding -> FAIL. >= 10 compared per symbol required. No file -> NOT_RUN -> panel INCOMPLETE.
check_4_cross_source.split_transform: Before comparison the retrieved file is put on the panel's split-adjusted basis: rows dated before a declared split's ex-date are divided by that split's factor. Declared splits: NVDA 10:1 first split-adjusted session 2024-06-10; AVGO 10:1 first split-adjusted session 2024-10-14; NFLX 10:1 first split-adjusted session 2025-11-17. All other universe names have no in-window split. The declared split list must be re-verified against Alpaca corporate-actions data at pull time; a mismatch makes the panel INCOMPLETE — the list is never edited silently.

data_verification.check_5_freeze: SHA-256 of every symbol's panel file with full request provenance written into data_provenance.json. A panel whose hash differs from its download-time draft is a FAIL, not a re-pin.
data_verification.gate: The SRS 5-check pattern (PROVENANCE.md section 3.5), applied per symbol. Panel verdict is PASS only if every symbol passes all five checks; any NOT_RUN makes the panel INCOMPLETE, never PASS. A panel that fails verification is not run.

declared_conventions.candidate_not_final_bar: The candidate bar may not be the session's final bar, guaranteeing at least one bar remains to manage the position. This coincides with SRS's 15:45 ET rule on full sessions and generalises it to early-close sessions.
declared_conventions.first_break_only: The session's first close beyond the range is its only entry candidate. Rationale: the first break is the ORB event; admitting a later re-break after a VWAP veto would add a second, path-dependent entry rule and a second hypothesis. The filter is a pure gate on the first break — the single claim under test.
declared_conventions.position_sizing: Not part of this family's identity; the backtest judges per-trade net returns. If the candidate ever reaches forward testing it inherits the fleet-standard decided risk package (FWD-006) unchanged.
declared_conventions.short_sale_constraints: Shorts are judged as price series under the programme cost model, like every RD family. No borrow fee, SSR or locate constraint is modelled, and none may be added after the fact; the 16/32 bps cost model is the only friction charged. Stated on the record before any run.

universe.no_substitution: No name may be added, dropped or substituted after this declaration for any reason. If a name fails the panel gate the panel is INCOMPLETE, not the universe editable. High-price low-share-volume names (e.g. COST, MA, UNH, HD) were excluded at declaration time because their median daily share volume sits below the 10M floor.
universe.selection_rule: US-listed common stocks continuously listed for the entire panel span (2023-01-01 to 2026-10-31), drawn from the S&P 500 / Nasdaq-100 liquidity leaders, each with full-span median daily share volume above the programme's 10M-share SIP floor (enforced per symbol by panel check 2, on split-adjusted shares as served).
universe.survivorship_note: A continuously-listed universe carries a mild survivorship tilt by construction; it is declared, not hidden, and matches the construction of the programme's other panels.

declared_conventions.vwap_through_candidate_inclusive: The filter reads VWAP through the candidate bar inclusive: the decision is made at that bar's close, when the bar is complete, so using its full OHLCV is causal (the SRS entry convention applied to the filter).

distinction_from_srs: Universe: SRS (TASK-IG2-STR-14) judges TSLA only; this family judges a frozen 15-symbol universe, pooled, as one cell, with a per-symbol breadth gate.

Filter: SRS has no VWAP component — its first close beyond the range enters unconditionally. Here the first close beyond the range is only a candidate; the session VWAP vetoes it or not, and a veto ends the symbol-session.

Target: SRS uses a fixed $10 on TSLA (a unit read from its source video). This family uses 2.0 x R, R = distance from entry to the opposite range end — range-relative, pooling across symbols and prices.

Source: SRS tests one creator's marketed claim ('81% win rate', unverified) recovered verbatim from a reel. This family tests no one's claim; it is a programme-discovery construction from the census slate.

Coincidence, stated plainly: both use the first two 15-minute candles (09:30-10:00 ET) as the opening range, the opposite range end as the stop, at most one trade per session, and a flat-by-close exit. Everything downstream of the range differs. TSLA is one of this family's fifteen pooled names under different rules — not a re-judgement of SRS's TSLA-only cell.

evaluation_bar.breadth: No single symbol contributes more than 50% of the pooled total positive net profit (census statement of the programme bar).
evaluation_bar.costs: Programme cost model (simulator.Costs(): 5 bps fee + 3 bps spread/slippage per side = 16 bps round trip) AND the identical simulation at 32 bps round trip; both must pass. Applied in price space exactly as the SRS harness applies them.
evaluation_bar.deletion_rule: Owner's rule: strict OOS profit factor < 1.2 deletes the family completely. A failed bar closes the family.
evaluation_bar.holdout: SRS TEMPORAL HOLDOUT v1 applies, adopted verbatim as this family's holdout leg on the pooled trade list: H1 holdout (W5) >= 20 trades (below: verdict FAIL (INSUFFICIENT_HOLDOUT_TRADES), window never extended); H2 holdout expectancy_net > 0; H3 development-OOS (W1-W4) expectancy_net > 0; H4 no fold contributes > 80% of total positive fold profit; H5 judged exactly once under the addendum section 2.3 procedure (debugging on synthetic bars or the pre-OOS segment only; trade list hash-pinned before metrics; any post-evaluation change burns the holdout permanently). Binding note: rd.common.holdout_check's universe is hardwired to the RD-001 crypto symbols, so the temporal construction is the holdout leg here (the SRS run's governance precedent adopted it over the weaker vacuous reading); the cross-sectional discipline is carried by the breadth gate — complements, not substitutes.
evaluation_bar.insufficient_trades_rule: Pooled OOS trades < 200 => the verdict is exactly 'insufficient OOS trades', never padded.
evaluation_bar.judgement: Pooled OOS trades only (all 15 symbols, folds W1-W5, entry-time attribution). Parameters frozen — nothing is selected in-sample.
evaluation_bar.multiple_testing: Bonferroni one-sided p < 0.05 / final_N. This declaration is ONE cell (one frozen configuration, one pooled universe panel). Counter at declaration: N = 3,891 declared. Lane order: SRS run -> 3,892; S-RD1 run -> 3,893; this family's run -> 3,894 if both land first (alpha approx 1.2839e-05). The run re-reads the programme ledger at run time and uses final_N = entering_N + 1; a busier programme can only tighten the bar. This declaration adds 0 trials until its run executes.
evaluation_bar.source: Stratex/rigorous_backtest/rd/common.py PROMOTION_BAR + programme practice; judging form mirrors the SRS harness (srs_signal.py judge).

hypothesis: On liquid US equities, the first 15-minute close beyond the 30-minute opening range, taken only when the close sits on the VWAP-consistent side of the session (above VWAP for a long, below for a short), with the stop at the opposite end of the range and a 2R target, carries enough intraday continuation — net of the programme cost model — to clear the RD programme bar on a pooled, full-history, per-symbol basis. The VWAP veto is the family's identity.

promotion_path: Passing the bar makes this a forward-test CANDIDATE only, under the Phase-3 forward protocol (>= 100 trades AND >= 8 weeks on demo). Nothing here authorises live trading.

rules.entry: at the candidate bar's close; at most ONE trade per symbol per session
rules.entry_candidate: the FIRST bar after the two range bars whose CLOSE is beyond the range (close > range high = long candidate; close < range low = short candidate). The candidate bar may not be the session's final bar (full session: closes by 15:45 ET; early-close session: closes by 12:45 ET). No close beyond the range means no trade that symbol-session.
rules.exit_evaluation: stop and target are evaluated from the NEXT bar onward; the entry bar's own extremes never trigger an exit (no lookahead). Within any bar the STOP is assumed hit before the TARGET (programme worst-case convention). A bar that opens beyond a level fills at that open (simulator gap convention).
rules.parameters_fixed: OR window = first 2 bars; TARGET_R = 2.0; VWAP formula as above; universe as below. Variants require a new declaration and raise the trial count.
rules.range: high = max high and low = min low of the FIRST TWO 15-minute bars of the session (bar-starts 09:30 and 09:45 ET); a symbol-session missing either bar, or with a zero-height range, produces no trade
rules.session_end: HARD flat-by-close: if neither stop nor target has triggered by the session's final bar, exit at that bar's close. Positions are never held overnight on any symbol for any reason.
rules.stop: the opposite end of the opening range — range low for a long, range high for a short. R = |entry - stop|.
rules.target: entry + 2.0 * R (long) / entry - 2.0 * R (short); TARGET_R = 2.0 frozen. No trailing, no partial exits, no breakeven move, no other management.
rules.universe: the 15 frozen symbols in declared_conventions.universe; 15-minute bars; US regular session only (09:30-16:00 America/New_York; 13:00 close on early-close days)
rules.vwap: session VWAP from the session's own 15-minute bars only: VWAP_t = sum(TP_i * V_i) / sum(V_i) over bars i = 1..t of the session, TP_i = (H_i + L_i + C_i) / 3, V_i = bar share volume as served by the panel. The vendor per-bar vwap field is NOT used. If cumulative volume through the candidate bar is zero, VWAP is undefined and the candidate is rejected.
rules.vwap_filter: a long candidate is taken only if its close is ABOVE the session VWAP computed through the candidate bar inclusive; a short candidate only if its close is BELOW that VWAP. If the first candidate fails the filter there is NO trade that symbol-session — no later breakout is considered (first-break-only convention).
